sections.skill: Sketch a graph from a description of a relationship

questions.skill: Sketch a graph from a description of a relationship
questions.prompt: Sketch a graph of the water level in a bathtub over time: it fills at a steady rate, stays the same while someone bathes, and then drains quickly.
questions.prompt_markup: Sketch a graph of the water level in a bathtub over time: it fills at a steady rate, stays the same while someone bathes, and then drains quickly.
questions.correct_answer: A rising straight segment from 0, then a horizontal segment, then a steeper falling segment back to 0. Any lengths are accepted if the order and steepness are right.

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 10 and y from 0 to 10. x-axis label "Time", y-axis label "Water level". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.

questions.skill: Sketch a graph from a description of a relationship
questions.prompt: Sketch a graph of a car's speed over time: it speeds up, travels at a steady speed, and then slows down to a stop.
questions.prompt_markup: Sketch a graph of a car's speed over time: it speeds up, travels at a steady speed, and then slows down to a stop.
questions.correct_answer: A rising segment from 0, a horizontal segment, then a falling segment back to 0. Any lengths are accepted if the order is right.

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 10 and y from 0 to 10. x-axis label "Time", y-axis label "Speed". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.

questions.skill: Sketch a graph from a description of a relationship
questions.prompt: Sketch the height of a ball thrown straight up over time: it rises, slows down, reaches a highest point, and falls back to the ground.
questions.prompt_markup: Sketch the height of a ball thrown straight up over time: it rises, slows down, reaches a highest point, and falls back to the ground.
questions.correct_answer: A curve that rises, levels off at one highest point, and falls back to height 0, like an upside-down U. Starting at ground level or at the throwing height is accepted.

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 10 and y from 0 to 10. x-axis label "Time", y-axis label "Height". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.

questions.skill: Sketch a graph from a description of a relationship
questions.prompt: Sketch the number of people in a theater from 6:00 to 10:00. It fills quickly before a 7:00 show, stays full, and empties after the show ends at 9:30.
questions.prompt_markup: Sketch the number of people in a theater from 6:00 to 10:00. It fills quickly before a 7:00 show, stays full, and empties after the show ends at 9:30.
questions.correct_answer: A steep rise before 7:00, a horizontal segment from about 7:00 to 9:30, then a steep fall after 9:30 back to about 0. Exact times are not required if the order is right.

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 10 and y from 0 to 10. x-axis label "Time", y-axis label "People in the theater". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.

questions.skill: Sketch a graph from a description of a relationship
questions.response: draw on the figure and write an answer
questions.prompt: Sketch a graph of a hike: the hiker climbs a steep trail for 2 hours, then a gentle slope for 1 hour, then rests for 1 hour. Is elevation a linear function of time for the whole hike? Explain.
questions.prompt_markup:
Sketch a graph of a hike: the hiker climbs a steep trail for 2 hours, then a gentle slope for 1 hour, then rests for 1 hour.
Is elevation a linear function of time for the whole hike? Explain.
questions.correct_answer: No. The rate of change is different on each part (steep, gentle, then zero), so the whole graph is not one line.
questions.drawing_answer: A steeper rising segment from 0 to 2 hours, a less steep rising segment from 2 to 3 hours, and a horizontal segment from 3 to 4 hours
questions.grading_note: Grade both: the three-part graph in the right order and steepness, and "no" with a reason.

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 10 and y from 0 to 10. x-axis label "Hours", y-axis label "Elevation". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.
